<a id="angry_shark"></a>
## Shark Score: `angry_shark.yml`

An orchestral score in the manner of Jaws: two low notes a half step apart, slow at first and faster
as the danger comes, the scenes ramping the tempo from 70 to 140 beats a minute and back, with a
horn call of its own.

<a id="four_wheels_g"></a>
## Eighties Synth Film Theme: `four_wheels_g.yml`

A mid-eighties synth theme in the manner of Axel F, with a hook of its own: a staccato saw lead
leaping octaves, a bouncing octave bass in sixteenths, chord stabs and bells.

<a id="get_the_traps_egon"></a>
## Spooky Funk Film Theme: `get_the_traps_egon.yml`

A mid-eighties funk-pop film theme in the manner of Ghostbusters, in G mixolydian, with a two-bar
synth bass riff, stabs and a brass hook of its own, and a sci-fi wail for the ghosts.

<a id="not_star_trek"></a>
## Symphonic Space Theme: `not_star_trek.yml`

A majestic symphonic theme in the manner of the original Battlestar Galactica's late-seventies
television theme, with a fanfare of its own: horns and trumpets over strings driving in triplets,
brass chords, timpani and a march on the snare, the opening and the bridge rising from quiet to full
by the scenes' Swell.

<a id="strange_woodworking"></a>
## Analog-Synth Score: `strange_woodworking.yml`

A dark synth score in the manner of Survive and John Carpenter: a held chord broken into a pulsing
sixteenth-note sequence by an arpeggiator, a deep bass, a halo pad and a slow square lead, with a
hat kept to a Euclidean rhythm by its track.

<a id="very_large_mammals"></a>
## Boogie-Woogie Film Tune: `very_large_mammals.yml`

A boogie-woogie tune in the manner of Baby Elephant Walk, shuffled by a factory groove: a walking
boogie bass through the twelve-bar blues, an organ, horn stabs on a dominant seventh and a calliope
with a tune of its own.
